The background is a white wall with geometric lines and soft indoor lighting. (2) As the video progresses, the man and the dog perform synchronized movements and facial expressions. The filters distort their features further, with the man's dog-head opening its mouth wide and the dog's human-mouth filter opening and closing rhythmically. At one point, the man leans forward quickly, briefly revealing his real face as he laughs before the filter re-engages. (3) The man leans back, and both the man and the dog continue to stare into the camera with exaggerated, humorous expressions. The man's dog-head filter opens wide in a final shouting pose while the dog in the back stays relatively still with its digital mouth wide open. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout the shots.
